meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 用基因表达数据推断基因调控网络,输出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系表,支持 GRNBoost2、GENIE3 算法并可分布式计算。
howto.when: 当用户要求从转录组数据(bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等)推断基因调控网络,或识别转录因子-靶基因关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这个单细胞表达矩阵推断基因调控网络。
say.note: Claude 会运行 GRNBoost2 并返回调控关系表。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 跑一下,输出重要性最高的前 5000 条调控关系。
say.note: 结果按 importance 排序截断。

say.text: 分别对三个条件下的表达数据推断调控网络并对比。
say.note: 循环读取各文件并逐一生成网络。

howto.what_en: Infers gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, outputting TF–target relationships; supports GRNBoost2, GENIE3, and distributed computation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to infer a GRN from transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, etc.) or to identify TF–target regulatory links.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this single-cell expression matrix.
say_en.note: Runs GRNBoost2 and returns the link table.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 and output the top 5000 regulatory links by importance.
say_en.note: Results are sorted by importance and truncated.

say_en.text: Infer and compare networks for expression data under three conditions.
say_en.note: Reads each file and generates a network per condition.
